columns.name: ProfileEvent_PatchesJoinRowsAddedToHashTable
columns.comment: Total number of rows added to hash tables when applying patch parts with Join mode

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ApplyPatchesMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent applying patch parts to blocks

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReadPatchesMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent reading patch parts

columns.name: ProfileEvent_BuildPatchesMergeMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent building indexes for applying patch parts with Merge mode

columns.name: ProfileEvent_BuildPatchesJoinMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent building indexes and hash tables for applying patch parts with Join mode

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ApplyPatchMergeOnKeyMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent inside applyPatchesMergeOnKey sort-key merge loops

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AnalyzePatchRangesMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent analyzing index of patch parts

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReadTasksWithAppliedMutationsOnFly
columns.comment: Total number of read tasks for which there was any mutation applied on fly

columns.name: ProfileEvent_MutationsAppliedOnFlyInAllReadTasks
columns.comment: Total number of applied mutations on-fly among all read tasks

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PatchesAcquireLockTries
columns.comment: Total number of tries to acquire lock for executing lightweight updates

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PatchesAcquireLockBadVersionRetries
columns.comment: Total number of retries while acquiring the lock for lightweight updates caused by a concurrent update committing first

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PatchesAcquireLockMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total number of microseconds spent to acquire lock for executing lightweight updates

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DiskObjectStorageWaitBlobRemovalMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent waiting for pending blob removal after committing metadata transaction

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SchedulerIOReadRequests
columns.comment: Resource requests passed through scheduler for IO reads.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SchedulerIOReadBytes
columns.comment: Bytes passed through scheduler for IO reads.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SchedulerIOReadWaitMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time a query was waiting on resource requests for IO reads.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SchedulerIOWriteRequests
columns.comment: Resource requests passed through scheduler for IO writes.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SchedulerIOWriteBytes
columns.comment: Bytes passed through scheduler for IO writes.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SchedulerIOWriteWaitMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time a query was waiting on resource requests for IO writes.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryMaskingRulesMatch
columns.comment: Number of times query masking rules was successfully matched.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReplicatedPartFetches
columns.comment: Number of times a data part was downloaded from replica of a ReplicatedMergeTree table.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReplicatedPartFailedFetches
columns.comment: Number of times a data part was failed to download from replica of a ReplicatedMergeTree table.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ObsoleteReplicatedParts
columns.comment: Number of times a data part was covered by another data part that has been fetched from a replica (so, we have marked a covered data part as obsolete and no longer needed).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReplicatedPartMerges
columns.comment: Number of times data parts of ReplicatedMergeTree tables were successfully merged.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReplicatedPartFetchesOfMerged
columns.comment: Number of times we prefer to download already merged part from replica of ReplicatedMergeTree table instead of performing a merge ourself (usually we prefer doing a merge ourself to save network traffic). This happens when we have not all source parts to perform a merge or when the data part is old enough.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReplicatedPartMutations
columns.comment: Number of times data parts of ReplicatedMergeTree tables were successfully mutated.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReplicatedPartChecks
columns.comment: Number of times we had to perform advanced search for a data part on replicas or to clarify the need of an existing data part.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReplicatedPartChecksFailed
columns.comment: Number of times the advanced search for a data part on replicas did not give result or when unexpected part has been found and moved away.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReplicatedDataLoss
columns.comment: Number of times a data part that we wanted doesn't exist on any replica (even on replicas that are offline right now). That data parts are definitely lost. This is normal due to asynchronous replication (if quorum inserts were not enabled), when the replica on which the data part was written was failed and when it became online after fail it doesn't contain that data part.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReplicatedCoveredPartsInZooKeeperOnStart
columns.comment: For debugging purposes. Number of parts in ZooKeeper that have a covering part, but doesn't exist on disk. Checked on server start.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QuorumParts
columns.comment: Number of data parts written with quorum. It counts as one part for sync insert and maybe up to async inserts count for insert which flushes async inserts.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QuorumWaitMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent waiting for quorum during inserts.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QuorumFailedInserts
columns.comment: Number of inserts failed due to quorum not reaching.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_InsertedRows
columns.comment: Number of rows INSERTed to all tables.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_InsertedBytes
columns.comment: Number of bytes (uncompressed; for columns as they stored in memory) INSERTed to all tables.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DelayedInserts
columns.comment: Number of times the INSERT of a block to a MergeTree table was throttled due to high number of active data parts for partition.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RejectedInserts
columns.comment: Number of times the INSERT of a block to a MergeTree table was rejected with 'Too many parts' exception due to high number of active data parts for partition.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DelayedInsertsMilliseconds
columns.comment: Total number of milliseconds spent while the INSERT of a block to a MergeTree table was throttled due to high number of active data parts for partition.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DelayedMutations
columns.comment: Number of times the mutation of a MergeTree table was throttled due to high number of unfinished mutations for table.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RejectedMutations
columns.comment: Number of times the mutation of a MergeTree table was rejected with 'Too many mutations' exception due to high number of unfinished mutations for table.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DelayedMutationsMilliseconds
columns.comment: Total number of milliseconds spent while the mutation of a MergeTree table was throttled due to high number of unfinished mutations for table.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RejectedLightweightUpdates
columns.comment: Number of time the lightweight update was rejected due to too many uncompressed bytes in patches.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedDelayedInserts
columns.comment: Number of times the INSERT of a block to a Distributed table was throttled due to high number of pending bytes.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedRejectedInserts
columns.comment: Number of times the INSERT of a block to a Distributed table was rejected with 'Too many bytes' exception due to high number of pending bytes.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedDelayedInsertsMilliseconds
columns.comment: Total number of milliseconds spent while the INSERT of a block to a Distributed table was throttled due to high number of pending bytes.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DuplicatedInsertedBlocks
columns.comment: Number of the synchronous inserts to a *MergeTree table was deduplicated.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SelfDuplicatedAsyncInserts
columns.comment: Number of async inserts in the INSERTed block to a ReplicatedMergeTree table was self deduplicated.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DuplicatedAsyncInserts
columns.comment: Number of async inserts in the INSERTed block to a ReplicatedMergeTree table was deduplicated.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DuplicationElapsedMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent checking for duplication of INSERTed blocks to *MergeTree tables.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DuplicationDataHashComputations
columns.comment: Number of column-wise data-hash computations performed while deduplicating INSERTed blocks to *MergeTree tables (cache misses in the unified deduplication hash).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperInit
columns.comment: Number of times connection with ZooKeeper has been established.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperTransactions
columns.comment: Number of ZooKeeper operations, which include both read and write operations as well as multi-transactions.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperList
columns.comment: Number of 'list' (getChildren) requests to ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperListRecursive
columns.comment: Number of 'listRecursive' requests to ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperListWithOptions
columns.comment: Number of 'listWithOptions' requests to ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperCreate
columns.comment: Number of 'create' requests to ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperRemove
columns.comment: Number of 'remove' requests to ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperExists
columns.comment: Number of 'exists' requests to ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperGet
columns.comment: Number of 'get' requests to ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperSet
columns.comment: Number of 'set' requests to ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperMulti
columns.comment: Number of 'multi' requests to ZooKeeper (compound transactions).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperMultiRead
columns.comment: Number of read 'multi' requests to ZooKeeper (compound transactions).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperMultiWrite
columns.comment: Number of write 'multi' requests to ZooKeeper (compound transactions).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperCheck
columns.comment: Number of 'check' requests to ZooKeeper. Usually they don't make sense in isolation, only as part of a complex transaction.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperSync
columns.comment: Number of 'sync' requests to ZooKeeper. These requests are rarely needed or usable.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperReconfig
columns.comment: Number of 'reconfig' requests to ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperClose
columns.comment: Number of times connection with ZooKeeper has been closed voluntary.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperGetACL
columns.comment: Number of 'getACL' requests to ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchResponse
columns.comment: Number of times watch notification has been received from ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchCallbackDurationMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent inside ZooKeeper watch callbacks (network thread).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchCallbackErrors
columns.comment: Number of exceptions thrown from ZooKeeper watch callbacks.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredOther
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to uncategorized callbacks.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredReplicatedMergeTreeLog
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to ReplicatedMergeTree log entries.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredReplicatedMergeTreeMutations
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to ReplicatedMergeTree mutations.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredReplicatedMergeTreeLeaderElection
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to ReplicatedMergeTree leader election / replica locks.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredReplicatedMergeTreeReplicaSync
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched while waiting for replicas to process log entries (SYNC REPLICA, ALTER, mutations).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredDistributedDDL
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to DDLWorker queue.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredReplicatedAccessControl
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to ReplicatedAccessStorage.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredUserDefinedSQLObjects
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to UserDefinedSQLObjectsZooKeeperStorage.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredWorkloadEntity
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to WorkloadEntityKeeperStorage.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredBackupCoordination
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to backup / restore coordination.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredObjectStorageQueue
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to ObjectStorageQueue / S3Queue.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredClusterDiscovery
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to ClusterDiscovery.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWatchTriggeredMaterializedViewRefresh
columns.comment: Number of watch notifications dispatched to MaterializedView refresh coordination.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperUserExceptions
columns.comment: Number of exceptions while working with ZooKeeper related to the data (no node, bad version or similar).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperHardwareExceptions
columns.comment: Number of exceptions while working with ZooKeeper related to network (connection loss or similar).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperOtherExceptions
columns.comment: Number of exceptions while working with ZooKeeper other than ZooKeeperUserExceptions and ZooKeeperHardwareExceptions.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperWaitMicroseconds
columns.comment: Number of microseconds spent waiting for responses from ZooKeeper after creating a request, summed across all the requesting threads.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperBytesSent
columns.comment: Number of bytes send over network while communicating with ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperBytesReceived
columns.comment: Number of bytes received over network while communicating with ZooKeeper.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedConnectionTries
columns.comment: Total count of distributed connection attempts.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedConnectionUsable
columns.comment: Total count of successful distributed connections to a usable server (with required table, but maybe stale).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedConnectionFailTry
columns.comment: Total count when distributed connection fails with retry.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedConnectionMissingTable
columns.comment: Number of times we rejected a replica from a distributed query, because it did not contain a table needed for the query.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedConnectionStaleReplica
columns.comment: Number of times we rejected a replica from a distributed query, because some table needed for a query had replication lag higher than the configured threshold.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedConnectionSkipReadOnlyReplica
columns.comment: Number of replicas skipped during INSERT into Distributed table due to replicas being read-only

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedConnectionFailAtAll
columns.comment: Total count when distributed connection fails after all retries finished.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedShardsSkipped
columns.comment: Number of shards silently skipped in a query to a Distributed table (or the remote/cluster table functions) when `skip_unavailable_shards` is enabled, either because the shard was unavailable or because it raised an exception covered by `skip_unavailable_shards_mode`.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_Shards
columns.comment: The number of shards involved in a query, summed across all distributed tables and table functions. A single host is counted multiple times if it appears in multiple tables. The number counts the total expected number of shards, which includes skipped shards with the `skip_unavailable_shards` setting.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_HedgedRequestsChangeReplica
columns.comment: Total count when timeout for changing replica expired in hedged requests.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SuspendSendingQueryToShard
columns.comment: Total count when sending query to shard was suspended when async_query_sending_for_remote is enabled.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_CompileFunction
columns.comment: Number of times a compilation of generated LLVM code (to create fused function for complex expressions) was initiated.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_CompiledFunctionExecute
columns.comment: Number of times a compiled function was executed.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ShortCircuitArgumentsReordered
columns.comment: Number of blocks on which the `and` or `or` function evaluated its arguments in an order different from the order in the query: a cheap argument before a heavy one, or according to the statistics collected on the previous blocks (setting `short_circuit_function_evaluation_reorder_arguments`). The reordering of the AND chain atoms in `WHERE` / `HAVING`, which is decided once when `FilterStep` bu…

columns.name: ProfileEvent_CompileExpressionsMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent for compilation of expressions to LLVM code.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_CompileExpressionsBytes
columns.comment: Number of bytes used for expressions compilation.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_CompileRegexpFunction
columns.comment: Number of times a regular expression was JIT-compiled to machine code.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExecuteShellCommand
columns.comment: Number of shell command executions.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalProcessingCompressedBytesTotal
columns.comment: Number of compressed bytes written by external processing (sorting/aggregating/joining)

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalProcessingUncompressedBytesTotal
columns.comment: Amount of data (uncompressed, before compression) written by external processing (sorting/aggregating/joining)

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalProcessingFilesTotal
columns.comment: Number of files used by external processing (sorting/aggregating/joining)

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSortWritePart
columns.comment: Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for sorting in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSortMerge
columns.comment: Number of times temporary files were merged for sorting in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSortCompressedBytes
columns.comment: Number of compressed bytes written for sorting in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSortUncompressedBytes
columns.comment: Amount of data (uncompressed, before compression) written for sorting in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalAggregationWritePart
columns.comment: Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for aggregation in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalAggregationMerge
columns.comment: Number of times temporary files were merged for aggregation in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalAggregationCompressedBytes
columns.comment: Number of bytes written to disk for aggregation in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalAggregationUncompressedBytes
columns.comment: Amount of data (uncompressed, before compression) written to disk for aggregation in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalJoinWritePart
columns.comment: Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for JOIN in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalJoinMerge
columns.comment: Number of times temporary files were merged for JOIN in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalJoinCompressedBytes
columns.comment: Number of compressed bytes written for JOIN in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalJoinUncompressedBytes
columns.comment: Amount of data (uncompressed, before compression) written for JOIN in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalDistinctWritePart
columns.comment: Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for DISTINCT in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalDistinctMerge
columns.comment: Number of times temporary files were merged for DISTINCT in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalDistinctTailSpilledRows
columns.comment: Number of buffered rows selected for spilling before the final external DISTINCT merge.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalDistinctTailKeptRows
columns.comment: Number of buffered rows retained in memory for the final external DISTINCT merge.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalDistinctCompressedBytes
columns.comment: Number of compressed bytes written for DISTINCT in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalDistinctUncompressedBytes
columns.comment: Amount of data (uncompressed, before compression) written for DISTINCT in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSetWritePart
columns.comment: Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for an `IN` set in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSetMerge
columns.comment: Number of times temporary files were merged for an `IN` set in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSetTailSpilledKeys
columns.comment: Number of keys in memory written to a temporary file before the final merge of an `IN` set in external memory, so that the merge fits within the spill threshold.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSetTailKeptKeys
columns.comment: Number of keys kept in memory for the final merge of an `IN` set in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSetCompressedBytes
columns.comment: Number of compressed bytes written for `IN` sets in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSetUncompressedBytes
columns.comment: Amount of data (uncompressed, before compression) written for `IN` sets in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSetReadBlocks
columns.comment: Number of blocks read from the temporary files of `IN` sets in external memory to look up keys.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSetCacheHits
columns.comment: Number of blocks that lookups in `IN` sets in external memory took from the cache of the set instead of reading them from the temporary file.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSetLookupKeys
columns.comment: Number of keys that lookups searched for in `IN` sets in external memory.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExternalSetBloomFilterSkippedKeys
columns.comment: Number of keys that the Bloom filters of `IN` sets in external memory ruled out during lookups.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_IcebergPartitionPrunedFiles
columns.comment: Number of skipped files during Iceberg partition pruning

columns.name: ProfileEvent_IcebergPartitionPrunedManifestFiles
columns.comment: Number of Iceberg manifest files skipped without being read, using the partition summaries of the manifest list

columns.name: ProfileEvent_IcebergTrivialCountOptimizationApplied
columns.comment: Trivial count optimization applied while reading from Iceberg

columns.name: ProfileEvent_IcebergVersionHintUsed
columns.comment: Number of times version-hint.text has been used.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_IcebergMinMaxIndexPrunedFiles
columns.comment: Number of skipped files by using MinMax index in Iceberg

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinBuildTableRowCount
columns.comment: Total number of rows in the build table for a JOIN operation.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinProbeTableRowCount
columns.comment: Total number of rows in the probe table for a JOIN operation.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinResultRowCount
columns.comment: Total number of rows in the result of a JOIN operation.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinNonJoinedTransformBlockCount
columns.comment: Number of blocks emitted by NonJoinedBlocksTransform.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinNonJoinedTransformRowCount
columns.comment: Number of non-joined rows emitted by NonJoinedBlocksTransform.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinNonJoinedHashTableScans
columns.comment: Number of times a RIGHT or FULL hash join scanned its hash table for non-joined rows.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinNonJoinedHashTableScansSkipped
columns.comment: Number of times a RIGHT or FULL hash join skipped scanning its hash table for non-joined rows, because every right key in the scanned part had matched.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinDelayedJoinedTransformBlockCount
columns.comment: Number of blocks emitted by DelayedJoinedBlocksWorkerTransform.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinDelayedJoinedTransformRowCount
columns.comment: Number of rows emitted by DelayedJoinedBlocksWorkerTransform.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinSpillingHashJoinSwitchedToGraceJoin
columns.comment: Number of times a (Concurrent)HashJoin was switched to GraceHashJoin due to memory limit in SpillingHashJoin.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinReorderMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent executing JOIN reordering algorithm.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinOptimizeMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent executing JOIN plan optimizations.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryPlanOptimizeMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent executing query plan optimizations.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryParseMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent parsing the query text into an AST.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryAnalysisMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent building the query tree and running analyzer passes (resolves identifiers, types, expressions).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryPlanBuildMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent building the QueryPlan from the analyzed query tree.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryPipelineBuildMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent constructing the QueryPipeline from the optimized QueryPlan.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DeltaLakePartitionPrunedFiles
columns.comment: Number of skipped files during DeltaLake partition pruning

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DeltaLakeSnapshotInitializations
columns.comment: Number of times a DeltaLake table snapshot was initialized (loaded from object storage)

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DeltaLakeScannedFiles
columns.comment: Number of files scanned during DeltaLake scan callbacks

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SlowRead
columns.comment: Number of reads from a file that were slow. This indicate system overload. Thresholds are controlled by read_backoff_* settings.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReadBackoff
columns.comment: Number of times the number of query processing threads was lowered due to slow reads.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReplicaPartialShutdown
columns.comment: How many times Replicated table has to deinitialize its state due to session expiration in ZooKeeper. The state is reinitialized every time when ZooKeeper is available again.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_IndexAnalysisRounds
columns.comment: Number of times index analysis was performed within the query.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_UniqueKeyIndexCacheLookupMicroseconds
columns.comment: Wall-clock time inside `UniqueKeyIndexCache::Lookup` + `UniqueKeyIndexCache::Insert` (ClickHouse-side `CacheBase` adapter for the RocksDB block cache).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_UniqueKeyIndexCacheHits
columns.comment: Number of times an entry has been found in the UNIQUE KEY index cache, so we didn't have to load an SST block.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_UniqueKeyIndexCacheMisses
columns.comment: Number of times an entry has not been found in the UNIQUE KEY index cache, so we had to load an SST block from disk.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_UniqueKeySSTWriteMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total wall-clock time spent inside an `SSTIndexWriter` lifetime — covers SST `Open`, every `addEncoded` Put, and `Finish` + `WriteBuffer` finalize (+ fsync) in `finish` (the SST bytes are streamed straight into the part storage's `WriteBuffer`). Excludes work the static helpers do before constructing the writer (encode + non-prefix-path sort). Emitted once per writer.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_UniqueKeyLoadTimeSSTRebuildCount
columns.comment: Number of UNIQUE KEY parts whose `unique_key_index.sst` was rebuilt at load time after the crash-before-flush window.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_UniqueKeyLoadTimeSSTRebuildMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent rebuilding `unique_key_index.sst` at load time (sequential read of UK columns + SST write).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SelectedParts

Names served from the internal DNS cache and host names that are…

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasReadAssignedForStealingMarks
columns.comment: Sum across all replicas of how many of scheduled marks were assigned for stealing by consistent hash

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasReadMarks
columns.comment: How many marks were read by the given replica

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReadPoolRangeRefinerDroppedMarks
columns.comment: How many marks were dropped from read tasks by a ranges refiner in MergeTree read pools (e.g. marks fully filtered out by a projection index)

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ReadPoolRangeRefinerDroppedCuts
columns.comment: How many times ranges cut from a part by a MergeTree read pool were fully dropped by a ranges refiner, so no read task was created for them

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasStealingByHashMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent collecting segments meant for stealing by hash

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasProcessingPartsMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent processing data parts

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasStealingLeftoversMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent collecting orphaned segments

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasCollectingOwnedSegmentsMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent collecting segments meant by hash

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasNumRequests
columns.comment: Number of requests to the initiator.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_CacheWarmerBytesDownloaded
columns.comment: Amount of data fetched into filesystem cache by dedicated background threads.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_CacheWarmerDataPartsDownloaded
columns.comment: Number of data parts that were fully fetched by CacheWarmer.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_IgnoredColdParts
columns.comment: See setting ignore_cold_parts_seconds. Number of times read queries ignored very new parts that weren't pulled into cache by CacheWarmer yet.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PreferredWarmedUnmergedParts
columns.comment: See setting prefer_warmed_unmerged_parts_seconds. Number of times read queries used outdated pre-merge parts that are in cache instead of merged part that wasn't pulled into cache by CacheWarmer yet.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfCPUCycles
columns.comment: Total cycles. Be wary of what happens during CPU frequency scaling.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfInstructions
columns.comment: Retired instructions. Be careful, these can be affected by various issues, most notably hardware interrupt counts.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfCacheReferences
columns.comment: Cache accesses. Usually, this indicates Last Level Cache accesses, but this may vary depending on your CPU. This may include prefetches and coherency messages; again this depends on the design of your CPU.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfCacheMisses
columns.comment: Cache misses. Usually this indicates Last Level Cache misses; this is intended to be used in conjunction with the PERFCOUNTHWCACHEREFERENCES event to calculate cache miss rates.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfBranchInstructions
columns.comment: Retired branch instructions. Prior to Linux 2.6.35, this used the wrong event on AMD processors.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfBranchMisses
columns.comment: Mispredicted branch instructions.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfBusCycles
columns.comment: Bus cycles, which can be different from total cycles.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfStalledCyclesFrontend
columns.comment: Stalled cycles during issue.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfStalledCyclesBackend
columns.comment: Stalled cycles during retirement.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfRefCPUCycles
columns.comment: Total cycles; not affected by CPU frequency scaling.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfCPUClock
columns.comment: The CPU clock, a high-resolution per-CPU timer

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfTaskClock
columns.comment: A clock count specific to the task that is running

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfContextSwitches
columns.comment: Number of context switches

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfCPUMigrations
columns.comment: Number of times the process has migrated to a new CPU

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfAlignmentFaults
columns.comment: Number of alignment faults. These happen when unaligned memory accesses happen; the kernel can handle these but it reduces performance. This happens only on some architectures (never on x86).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfEmulationFaults
columns.comment: Number of emulation faults. The kernel sometimes traps on unimplemented instructions and emulates them for user space. This can negatively impact performance.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfMinEnabledTime
columns.comment: For all events, minimum time that an event was enabled. Used to track event multiplexing influence

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfMinEnabledRunningTime
columns.comment: Running time for event with minimum enabled time. Used to track the amount of event multiplexing

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfDataTLBReferences
columns.comment: Data TLB references

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfDataTLBMisses
columns.comment: Data TLB misses

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfInstructionTLBReferences
columns.comment: Instruction TLB references

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfInstructionTLBMisses
columns.comment: Instruction TLB misses

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfLocalMemoryReferences
columns.comment: Local NUMA node memory reads

columns.name: ProfileEvent_PerfLocalMemoryMisses
columns.comment: Local NUMA node memory read misses

columns.name: ProfileEvent_CannotWriteToWriteBufferDiscard
columns.comment: Number of stack traces dropped by query profiler or signal handler because pipe is full or cannot write to pipe.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryProfilerSignalOverruns
columns.comment: Number of times we drop processing of a query profiler signal due to overrun plus the number of signals that OS has not delivered due to overrun.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryProfilerConcurrencyOverruns
columns.comment: Number of times we drop processing of a query profiler signal due to too many concurrent query profilers in other threads, which may indicate overload.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryProfilerRuns
columns.comment: Number of times QueryProfiler had been run.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryProfilerErrors
columns.comment: Invalid memory accesses during asynchronous stack unwinding.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_CreatedLogEntryForMerge
columns.comment: Successfully created log entry to merge parts in ReplicatedMergeTree.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_NotCreatedLogEntryForMerge
columns.comment: Log entry to merge parts in ReplicatedMergeTree is not created due to concurrent log update by another replica.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_CreatedLogEntryForMutation
columns.comment: Successfully created log entry to mutate parts in ReplicatedMergeTree.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_NotCreatedLogEntryForMutation
columns.comment: Log entry to mutate parts in ReplicatedMergeTree is not created due to concurrent log update by another replica.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_MetadataTransactionRollbacksFailed

columns.name: ProfileEvent_MemoryAllocatedWithoutCheck
columns.comment: Number of times memory has been allocated without checking for memory constraints.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_MemoryAllocatedWithoutCheckBytes
columns.comment: Amount of bytes that has been allocated without checking for memory constraints.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryMemoryDriftSettled
columns.comment: Number of queries that ended with memory still charged to them (or over-credited). The difference is taken off the per-user tracker, so that it ends at zero for the query.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryMemoryDriftSettledBytes
columns.comment: Absolute amount of bytes taken off per-user trackers when queries ended, that is, how far per-query accounting was off.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_MemoryLargeAllocationTraced
columns.comment: Number of times a stack trace was captured for a single charge to the global memory tracker at or above `min_allocation_size_to_log_stack_trace`.

columns.comment: Distributed Cache client event. Total number of distributed cache errors during write requests (equals DistrCacheWriteErrorsRetriable + DistrCacheWriteErrorsNonRetriable). A server-initiated write-through cache `Stop` is flow control, not an error, and is not counted

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheWriteErrorsRetriable
columns.comment: Distributed Cache client event. Number of retriable distributed cache errors during write requests (counted on each occurrence, including the ones recovered by a retry)

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheWriteErrorsNonRetriable

columns.comment: Distributed Cache write buffer event. Number of times a retriable write error did not succeed within the write request retries limit

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheWriteMicroseconds
columns.comment: Distributed Cache write buffer event. Time spent in WriteBufferFromDistributedCache::writeToFileSegment

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheWriteBytes

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheObjectStorageWriteMicroseconds

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheObjectStorageWriteBytes
columns.comment: Distributed Cache write buffer event. Number of bytes written to object storage

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheBackgroundWrites
columns.comment: Distributed Cache write buffer event. Number of cache writes that ran on a background thread (a background write slot was acquired)

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheInlineWrites
columns.comment: Distributed Cache write buffer event. Number of cache writes that ran inline on the calling thread (writes of temporary data, which has no object storage write to overlap with)

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheSkippedWrites
columns.comment: Distributed Cache write buffer event. Number of write buffers that skipped the write-through cache write because no background write slot was free (the limit set by the `distributed_cache_write_pool_size` server setting was reached) or a background write could not be started. The data is still written to object storage

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheGetResponseMicroseconds
columns.comment: Distributed Cache client event. Time spend to wait for response from distributed cache

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheConnectErrors
columns.comment: Distributed Cache client event. Number of failures to connect to a distributed cache server before making a request (counted once per request, after all connect attempts are exhausted, unlike per-attempt DistrCacheUnsuccessfulConnectAttempts). A timeout while waiting for a free pooled connection is counted here as well. Failures to reconnect during request creation are counted in DistrCacheMake…

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheMakeRequestErrors
columns.comment: Distributed Cache client event. Number of distributed cache errors when making a request

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheReceiveResponseErrors
columns.comment: Distributed Cache client event. Number of distributed cache errors when receiving response a request

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistrCacheSystemTablesErrors
columns.comment: Distributed Cache client event. Number of distributed cache errors during introspection system table requests (system.distributed_cache, system.distributed_cache_metrics, system.distributed_cache_events). These requests are not retried, so retriable and non-retriable errors are counted together

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasUsedCount
columns.comment: Number of replicas used to execute a query with task-based parallel replicas

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasAvailableCount
columns.comment: Number of replicas available to execute a query with task-based parallel replicas

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasUnavailableCount
columns.comment: Number of replicas which was chosen, but found to be unavailable during query execution with task-based parallel replicas

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedPlanRemoteTasks
columns.comment: Number of tasks dispatched to remote workers when executing a query with make_distributed_plan. A non-zero value means the query was actually executed distributedly.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedPlanLocalExecution
columns.comment: Set to 1 when a make_distributed_plan query was executed in-process via the local executor (distributed_plan_execute_locally) instead of being dispatched to remote workers.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedPlanHostsUsed
columns.comment: Number of distinct hosts that were assigned at least one task when executing a query with make_distributed_plan.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedPlanWorkerPartsReceived
columns.comment: Number of data parts the coordinator assigned to a worker of a distributed query plan, summed over the bucketed reads a query runs on that worker. A part assigned to several buckets counts once per read.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedPlanWorkerPartsScanned
columns.comment: Number of the assigned data parts the worker keeps to read.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedPlanWorkerPartsPruned
columns.comment: Number of the assigned data parts the worker's own index analysis pruned, so the worker does not read them. The coordinator selects parts without that analysis, so it can assign a part no row of the query can match. `DistributedPlanWorkerPartsReceived` is the sum of this and `DistributedPlanWorkerPartsScanned`.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StreamingExchangeSendBytes
columns.comment: Bytes written to the sockets of the streaming exchanges of a distributed query plan. `NetworkSendBytes` does not count them.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StreamingExchangeReceiveBytes
columns.comment: Bytes read from the sockets of the streaming exchanges of a distributed query plan. `NetworkReceiveBytes` does not count them.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StreamingExchangePacketsSent
columns.comment: Data packets written whole to the sockets of streaming exchanges, one per chunk plus one end-of-stream packet per stream. A packet is counted when it is written whole; a packet cut short because the receiver needed no more data is not counted.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StreamingExchangePacketsReceived
columns.comment: Data packets read from streaming exchanges, one per chunk plus one end-of-stream packet per stream.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StreamingExchangeSerializedBytes
columns.comment: Bytes of the Native blocks in streaming exchange packets before compression, counted once per packet where it is serialized. Against `StreamingExchangeSendBytes` this gives the compression ratio of a shuffle or a gather; a broadcast sends every packet to each destination, so there `StreamingExchangeSendBytes` grows with the number of destinations.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StreamingExchangeSerializeMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent serializing and compressing chunks into streaming exchange packets.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StreamingExchangeDeserializeMicroseconds

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetFetchWaitTimeMicroseconds

columns.name: ProfileEvent_WasmSerializationMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent executing WebAssembly code

columns.name: ProfileEvent_WasmDeserializationMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent executing WebAssembly code

columns.name: ProfileEvent_WasmGuestExecuteMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent executing WebAssembly code

columns.name: ProfileEvent_WasmTotalExecuteMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent executing WebAssembly code

columns.name: ProfileEvent_WasmModuleInstatiate
columns.comment: Number of WebAssembly compartments created

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExecutableUserDefinedFunctionInvocations
columns.comment: Number of executable and executable_pool user-defined function invocations.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExecutableUserDefinedFunctionElapsedMicroseconds
columns.comment: Wall clock time spent executing executable and executable_pool user-defined functions, in microseconds.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExecutableUserDefinedFunctionUserTimeMicroseconds
columns.comment: User mode CPU time consumed by executable and executable_pool user-defined function child processes, in microseconds.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExecutableUserDefinedFunctionSystemTimeMicroseconds
columns.comment: Kernel mode CPU time consumed by executable and executable_pool user-defined function child processes, in microseconds.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExecutableUserDefinedFunctionPeakMemoryByteSeconds
columns.comment: Per-process peak memory used by executable and executable_pool user-defined function child processes integrated over wall clock time, in byte-seconds.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExecutableUserDefinedFunctionInputBytes
columns.comment: Total bytes written to the stdin of executable and executable_pool user-defined function child processes.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExecutableUserDefinedFunctionOutputBytes
columns.comment: Total bytes read from the stdout of executable and executable_pool user-defined function child processes.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ExecutableUserDefinedFunctionPoolWaitMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent waiting on tryBorrowObject when the executable_pool user-defined function pool is exhausted, in microseconds.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetReadRowGroups
columns.comment: The total number of row groups read from parquet data

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetPrunedRowGroups
columns.comment: The total number of row groups pruned from parquet data

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetTopKSkippedRowGroups
columns.comment: The number of parquet row groups skipped while reading because their min/max statistics showed that they can't contain rows of the `ORDER BY ... LIMIT` result (see `use_top_k_dynamic_filtering`)

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetReadMinMaxFromStatistics
columns.comment: The number of parquet files whose `min` / `max` were computed from column chunk statistics instead of reading the data (see `optimize_min_max_from_files`)

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetReadPages
columns.comment: The total number of Parquet data pages read

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetPrunedPages
columns.comment: The total number of pages pruned from parquet data via column index

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetDecodingTasks
columns.comment: Tasks issued by parquet reader

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetDecodingTaskBatches
columns.comment: Task groups sent to a thread pool by parquet reader

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetPrefetcherReadRandomRead
columns.comment: The total number of reads with ReadMode::RandomRead by DB::Parquet::Prefetcher

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetPrefetcherReadSeekAndRead
columns.comment: The total number of reads with ReadMode::SeekAndRead by DB::Parquet::Prefetcher

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetPrefetcherReadEntireFile
columns.comment: The total number of read with ReadMode::EntireFileIsInMemory by DB::Parquet::Prefetcher

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetRowsFilterExpression
columns.comment: The total number of rows that were passed through filter

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParquetColumnsFilterExpression
columns.comment: The total number of columns that were passed through filter

columns.name: ProfileEvent_FilterTransformPassedRows
columns.comment: Number of rows that passed the filter in the query

columns.name: ProfileEvent_FilterTransformPassedBytes
columns.comment: Number of bytes that passed the filter in the query

columns.name: ProfileEvent_QueryPreempted
columns.comment: How many times tasks are paused and waiting due to 'priority' setting

columns.name: ProfileEvent_IndexBinarySearchAlgorithm
columns.comment: Number of times the binary search algorithm is used over the index marks

columns.name: ProfileEvent_IndexGenericExclusionSearchAlgorithm
columns.comment: Number of times the generic exclusion search algorithm is used over the index marks

columns.name: ProfileEvent_IndexGenericExclusionSearchStepLimitReached
columns.comment: Number of times the generic exclusion search over the index marks reached merge_tree_generic_exclusion_search_max_steps and accepted the remaining mark ranges without further splitting

columns.name: ProfileEvent_ParallelReplicasQueryCount
columns.comment: Number of (sub)queries planned to be executed using parallel replicas during a query execution. Automatic parallel replicas also increments this for the plan it builds to make its decision, so a counted query may never have run with parallel replicas - see `AutoParallelReplicasApplied` and `ParallelReplicasUsedCount` for what was actually executed

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasSkippedDueToSettings
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas skipped a query before building the plan with parallel replicas, because of the settings it was given. The `AutoParallelReplicas` logger says which case it was. Settings that switch automatic parallel replicas off altogether are not counted: with `enable_parallel_replicas` disabled or forced, or `parallel_replicas_mode` other than `read_tasks`, the op…

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasSkippedDueToQuery
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas skipped a query before building the plan with parallel replicas, because the query has a feature it cannot handle, such as a join that cannot be read with parallel replicas or a step that cannot collect statistics. The `AutoParallelReplicas` logger says which case it was

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutomaticParallelReplicasProbePlansBuilt
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas built a plan with parallel replicas in order to decide whether it pays off

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutomaticParallelReplicasDecidedWithoutBuildingPlan
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas decided against using parallel replicas at a boundary remembered from an earlier execution, without building a candidate plan to cost. The event saying why, such as `AutoParallelReplicasRejectedByCostModel`, is counted beside it

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasOptimizationMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent in the automatic parallel replicas optimization other than building the plan with parallel replicas

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasPlanBuildMicroseconds
columns.comment: Time spent building the plan with parallel replicas that automatic parallel replicas compares against the local plan

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasPlansNotComparable
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas skipped a query after building the plan with parallel replicas, or at a boundary remembered from building it earlier, because it could not match that plan with the local one well enough to compare or use it: for example, it could not pair their reads, or tell which read the replicas would split. The `AutoParallelReplicas` logger says which case it was

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasPlanWithoutParallelReplicas
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas skipped a query after building the plan with parallel replicas, because the planner did not use parallel replicas in it, for example for too few rows per replica or a correlated subquery. The `Planner` logger says why

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasNoStatistics
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas had no statistics yet, so it collected them instead of deciding

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasStatisticsDrifted
columns.comment: Number of times the rows read from storage differed from the cached statistics by more than 2x, so automatic parallel replicas recollected them instead of deciding

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasCostModelEvaluated
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas reached the cost model and compared the local plan against the parallel replicas plan

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasApplied
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas replaced the query plan with the parallel replicas one

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasSkippedEarly
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas did not even build the plan with parallel replicas, because index analysis already showed the largest read in the plan gives less than `automatic_parallel_replicas_min_bytes_per_replica` per replica

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasRejectedByThreshold
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas declined although the cost model favoured parallel replicas, because the read was below `automatic_parallel_replicas_min_bytes_per_replica`

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasRejectedByDuplicatedReads
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas declined although the cost model favoured parallel replicas, because too large a share of the bytes read would be read by every replica in full rather than split between them, above `automatic_parallel_replicas_max_duplicated_read_ratio`

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasRejectedByCostModel
columns.comment: Number of times automatic parallel replicas declined because the cost model estimated the local plan to be at least as fast as the parallel replicas one

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AutoParallelReplicasBytesPerReplica
columns.comment: How many bytes per replica the read of this query gives, as automatic parallel replicas sized it - recorded whatever was decided, so the distribution covers both the queries `automatic_parallel_replicas_min_bytes_per_replica` turns away and the ones it lets through

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedConnectionReconnectCount
columns.comment: Number of reconnects to other servers done during distributed query execution. It can happen when a stale connection has been acquired from connection pool

columns.name: ProfileEvent_DistributedConnectionConnectCount
columns.comment: Number of connects to other servers done during distributed query execution. Happens when new connection is established instead of using existing from pool.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RefreshableViewRefreshSuccess
columns.comment: How many times refreshable materialized views refreshed

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RefreshableViewRefreshFailed
columns.comment: How many times refreshable materialized views failed to refresh

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RefreshableViewSyncReplicaSuccess
columns.comment: How many times a SELECT from refreshable materialized view did an implicit SYNC REPLICA

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RefreshableViewSyncReplicaRetry
columns.comment: How many times a SELECT from refreshable materialized view failed and retried an implicit SYNC REPLICA

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RefreshableViewLockTableRetry
columns.comment: How many times a SELECT from refreshable materialized view had to switch to a new table because the old table was dropped

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AsyncLoggingConsoleTotalMessages
columns.comment: How many messages (accepted or dropped) have been sent to the async queue for the console log

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AsyncLoggingFileLogTotalMessages
columns.comment: How many messages (accepted or dropped) have been sent to the async queue for the file log

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AsyncLoggingErrorFileLogTotalMessages
columns.comment: How many messages (accepted or dropped) have been sent to the async queue for the error file log

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AsyncLoggingSyslogTotalMessages
columns.comment: How many messages (accepted or dropped) have been sent to the async queue for the syslog

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AsyncLoggingTextLogTotalMessages
columns.comment: How many messages (accepted or dropped) have been sent to the async queue for the text_log

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AsyncLoggingConsoleDroppedMessages
columns.comment: How many messages have been dropped from the console log due to the async log queue being full

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AsyncLoggingFileLogDroppedMessages
columns.comment: How many messages have been dropped from the file log due to the async log queue being full

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AsyncLoggingErrorFileLogDroppedMessages
columns.comment: How many messages have been dropped from error file log due to the async log queue being full

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AsyncLoggingSyslogDroppedMessages
columns.comment: How many messages have been dropped from the syslog due to the async log queue being full

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AsyncLoggingTextLogDroppedMessages
columns.comment: How many messages have been dropped from text_log due to the async log queue being full

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JemallocFailedAllocationSampleTracking
columns.comment: Total number of times tracking of jemalloc allocation sample failed

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JemallocFailedDeallocationSampleTracking
columns.comment: Total number of times tracking of jemalloc deallocation sample failed

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SetsBuiltFromSubquery
columns.comment: Number of `IN`/`JOIN` sets filled by running their subquery. A set taken from the prepared sets cache, or already built and reused, is not counted.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SetsSpilledToDisk
columns.comment: Number of `IN` sets that spilled to disk, while they were built from their subquery or while the query used them.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_LoadedStatisticsMicroseconds
columns.comment: Elapsed time of loading statistics from parts

columns.name: ProfileEvent_LoadedStatistics
columns.comment: Number of data parts whose column statistics were collected for the selectivity estimator, either from the statistics cache or from the part itself

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SelectivityEstimatorInSetNotBuilt
columns.comment: Number of `IN` conditions the selectivity estimator could not analyse because the set was not built yet, and it must not run the subquery to fill it

columns.name: ProfileEvent_SelectivityEstimatorInSetEstimatedFromSize
columns.comment: Number of `IN` conditions whose selectivity was estimated from the size and bounds of the set instead of its exact ranges, because the set exceeds `statistics_max_set_size_for_exact_selectivity_estimation`

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeDataflowStatisticsInputBytes
columns.comment: Collected statistics on the number of bytes replicas would read if the query was executed with parallel replicas

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeDataflowStatisticsOutputBytes
columns.comment: Collected statistics on the number of bytes replicas would send to the initiator if the query was executed with parallel replicas

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeDataflowStatisticsInputNanoseconds
columns.comment: Time spent during query execution collecting statistics on the number of bytes replicas would read, for automatic parallel replicas

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeDataflowStatisticsOutputNanoseconds
columns.comment: Time spent during query execution collecting statistics on the number of bytes replicas would send to the initiator, for automatic parallel replicas

columns.name: ProfileEvent_S3CachedCredentialsProvidersReused
columns.comment: Total number of reused credentials provider from the cache

columns.name: ProfileEvent_S3CachedCredentialsProvidersAdded
columns.comment: Total number of newly added credentials providers to the cache

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFiltersCreated
columns.comment: Number of distinct JOIN Runtime Filters created within a query

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterBlocksProcessed
columns.comment: Number of blocks processed by JOIN Runtime Filters

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterBlocksSkipped
columns.comment: Number of blocks skipped by JOIN Runtime Filters without processing due to filter being dynamically disabled because of poor filtering ratio

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterRowsChecked
columns.comment: Number of rows checked by JOIN Runtime Filters

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterRowsPassed
columns.comment: Number of rows that passed (not filtered out by) JOIN Runtime Filters

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterRowsSkipped
columns.comment: Number of rows in blocks that were skipped by JOIN Runtime Filters

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterStatesSent
columns.comment: Number of JOIN Runtime Filter states queued for sending to other tasks of a distributed query plan, one per destination stream, including deliveries abandoned later

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterStateBytesSent
columns.comment: Bytes of serialized JOIN Runtime Filter states sent to other tasks of a distributed query plan, counted once per destination stream

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterStatesReceived
columns.comment: Number of serialized JOIN Runtime Filter states received from other tasks of a distributed query plan

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterStateBytesReceived
columns.comment: Bytes of serialized JOIN Runtime Filter states received from other tasks of a distributed query plan

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterOversizedStatesRejected
columns.comment: Number of JOIN Runtime Filter states not used or not sent because they exceeded the size limit; rows pass unfiltered

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterDeliveriesAbandoned
columns.comment: Number of JOIN Runtime Filter deliveries abandoned because the receiver disconnected or stopped reading; the affected destination gets no filter and its rows pass unfiltered

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterReceivesAbandoned
columns.comment: Number of JOIN Runtime Filter streams whose sender disconnected after the connection was established, before the end of the stream; if the sender's state had not arrived, the affected filter is not used and rows pass unfiltered

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterReceiveBranchFailures
columns.comment: Number of tasks that failed to receive a JOIN Runtime Filter from another task; that task does not use the filter and rows pass unfiltered

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterBloomFilterBuildsSkipped
columns.comment: Number of JOIN Runtime Filter Bloom filter builds skipped because the build-side key count from the hash table statistics predicted that the filter would exceed the maximal ratio of set bits

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterIndexAnalysisReads
columns.comment: Number of reads set up to prune granules with a JOIN runtime filter at read time. Counted when the read reaches its pipeline carrying the descriptors and has a primary key or skip index to prune them with, whether or not a granule is later examined, so it shows that the descriptors survived every rebuild of the read step.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterGranulesConsidered
columns.comment: Number of granules examined for read time pruning by JOIN Runtime Filters

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterGranulesDropped
columns.comment: Number of granules pruned at read time by JOIN Runtime Filters

columns.name: ProfileEvent_RuntimeFilterLookupsBeforeBuildFinished
columns.comment: Number of blocks looked up in a JOIN Runtime Filter whose build side had not finished yet, which pass through unfiltered

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinBuildPostProcessingMicroseconds
columns.comment: Elapsed time of post-processing steps after building the right JOIN side.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_JoinBuildRowStoreMicroseconds
columns.comment: Elapsed time transforming the right JOIN side payload into row-major format.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AIInputTokens
columns.comment: Total prompt tokens consumed across all AI function calls in the query.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AIOutputTokens
columns.comment: Total completion tokens consumed across all AI function calls in the query.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AIAPICalls
columns.comment: Number of HTTP requests dispatched to AI providers.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AIAPICallsRetried
columns.comment: Number of AI provider requests retried after a transient failure.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AIAPICallsFailed
columns.comment: Number of AI provider requests that failed after all retries.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AIAPICallsThrottled
columns.comment: Number of AI provider requests rejected with HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AIRowsProcessed
columns.comment: Number of rows that received an AI result.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_AIRowsSkipped
columns.comment: Number of rows that received a default value due to quota or error.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_YTsaurusLookupThrottled
columns.comment: Number of lookup requests to YTsaurus that were throttled

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerRequested
columns.comment: Number of stateless workers requested by queries for distributed query execution.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerProvided
columns.comment: Number of stateless workers provided to queries for distributed query execution.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerProvisioningMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time queries spent waiting for stateless workers to be provisioned.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerProvisioningWaits
columns.comment: Number of times a query had to wait for the stateless worker discovery service to provide workers.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerNotAccessible
columns.comment: Number of times a leased stateless worker was found not yet reachable and excluded from query allocation until it passes the accessibility check.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerTimeToAvailableMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time (summed across workers) between a leased stateless worker first appearing from the discovery service and it passing the accessibility check to become available for query execution.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerCreateLeaseRequests
columns.comment: Number of create_lease requests sent to the stateless worker discovery service to acquire workers.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerCreateLeaseMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent in create_lease requests to the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerCreateLeaseErrors
columns.comment: Number of failed create_lease requests to the stateless worker discovery service (any error or timeout).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerGetLeaseRequests
columns.comment: Number of get_lease requests sent to the stateless worker discovery service to refresh the list of leased workers.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerGetLeaseMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent in get_lease requests to the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerGetLeaseErrors
columns.comment: Number of failed get_lease requests to the stateless worker discovery service (any error or timeout).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerUpdateLeaseRequests
columns.comment: Number of update_lease requests sent to the stateless worker discovery service to renew worker leases.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerUpdateLeaseMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time spent in update_lease requests to the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerUpdateLeaseErrors
columns.comment: Number of failed update_lease requests to the stateless worker discovery service (any error or timeout).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerServerRegisterRequests
columns.comment: Number of registration requests a stateless worker sent to the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerServerRegisterMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time stateless workers spent registering with the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerServerRegisterErrors
columns.comment: Number of failed registration requests from stateless workers to the stateless worker discovery service (any error or timeout).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerServerHeartbeatRequests
columns.comment: Number of heartbeats a stateless worker sent to the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerServerHeartbeatMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time stateless workers spent sending heartbeats to the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerServerHeartbeatErrors
columns.comment: Number of failed heartbeats from stateless workers to the stateless worker discovery service (any error or timeout).

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerServerTenantBindings
columns.comment: Number of times a stateless worker was assigned to a tenant to serve its queries.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerServerLeasesLost
columns.comment: Number of times a stateless worker's lease ended and it began awaiting shutdown.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryCreateLeaseRequests
columns.comment: Number of create_lease requests handled by the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryCreateLeaseErrors
columns.comment: Number of create_lease requests the stateless worker discovery service answered with an error.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryCreateLeaseMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time the stateless worker discovery service spent handling create_lease requests.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryUpdateLeaseRequests
columns.comment: Number of update_lease requests handled by the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryUpdateLeaseErrors
columns.comment: Number of update_lease requests the stateless worker discovery service answered with an error.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryUpdateLeaseMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time the stateless worker discovery service spent handling update_lease requests.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryGetLeaseRequests
columns.comment: Number of get_lease requests handled by the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryGetLeaseErrors
columns.comment: Number of get_lease requests the stateless worker discovery service answered with an error.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryGetLeaseMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time the stateless worker discovery service spent handling get_lease requests.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryCreateWorkerRequests
columns.comment: Number of create_worker requests handled by the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryCreateWorkerErrors
columns.comment: Number of create_worker requests the stateless worker discovery service answered with an error.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryCreateWorkerMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time the stateless worker discovery service spent handling create_worker requests.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryDeleteWorkerRequests
columns.comment: Number of delete_worker requests handled by the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryDeleteWorkerErrors
columns.comment: Number of delete_worker requests the stateless worker discovery service answered with an error.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryDeleteWorkerMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time the stateless worker discovery service spent handling delete_worker requests.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryGetWorkerRequests
columns.comment: Number of get_worker requests handled by the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryGetWorkerErrors
columns.comment: Number of get_worker requests the stateless worker discovery service answered with an error.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryGetWorkerMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time the stateless worker discovery service spent handling get_worker requests.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryHeartbeatRequests
columns.comment: Number of heartbeat requests handled by the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryHeartbeatErrors
columns.comment: Number of heartbeat requests the stateless worker discovery service answered with an error.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryHeartbeatMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time the stateless worker discovery service spent handling heartbeat requests.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryListWorkersRequests
columns.comment: Number of list_workers requests handled by the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryListWorkersErrors
columns.comment: Number of list_workers requests the stateless worker discovery service answered with an error.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryListWorkersMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time the stateless worker discovery service spent handling list_workers requests.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryTenantRequests
columns.comment: Number of tenant management requests (create, update, delete, get, or list tenant) handled by the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryTenantErrors
columns.comment: Number of tenant management requests the stateless worker discovery service answered with an error.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryTenantMicroseconds
columns.comment: Total time the stateless worker discovery service spent handling tenant management requests.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryInternalErrors
columns.comment: Number of requests the stateless worker discovery service failed to handle because of an internal error (an exception or a coordination-store failure), rather than rejecting an invalid request.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryWorkersLeased
columns.comment: Number of stateless workers newly leased to tenants by the stateless worker discovery service.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryWorkersUnavailable
columns.comment: Number of stateless workers that tenants requested but the stateless worker discovery service could not provide because no free workers were available or the tenant worker limit was reached.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryWorkersLeaseExpired
columns.comment: Number of stateless workers reclaimed by the stateless worker discovery service because their lease expired.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryWorkersHeartbeatExpired
columns.comment: Number of stateless workers reclaimed by the stateless worker discovery service because they stopped sending heartbeats.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryHeartbeatsRejected
columns.comment: Number of heartbeats the stateless worker discovery service rejected because the worker had already been evicted.

columns.name: ProfileEvent_StatelessWorkerDiscoveryKeeperTransactionRetries
columns.comment: Number of write transactions the stateless worker discovery service retried because its coordination store (Keeper) state was modified concurrently.

name: all_query_thread_log
comment: Union of the `query_thread_log` table and its rotated versions.

columns.name: hostname
columns.comment: Hostname of the server executing the query.

columns.name: clickhouse_version
columns.comment: Version of the ClickHouse server that produced the row.

columns.name: system_processor
columns.comment: CPU architecture of the ClickHouse server that produced the row.

columns.name: event_date
columns.comment: The date when the thread has finished execution of the query.

columns.name: event_time
columns.comment: The date and time when the thread has finished execution of the query.

columns.name: event_time_microseconds
columns.comment: The date and time when the thread has finished execution of the query with microseconds precision.

columns.name: query_start_time
columns.comment: Start time of query execution.

columns.name: query_start_time_microseconds
columns.comment: Start time of query execution with microsecond precision.

columns.name: query_duration_ms
columns.comment: Duration of query execution.

columns.name: read_rows
columns.comment: Number of read rows.

columns.name: read_bytes
columns.comment: Number of read bytes.

columns.name: written_rows
columns.comment: For INSERT queries, the number of written rows. For other queries, the column value is 0.

columns.name: written_bytes
columns.comment: For INSERT queries, the number of written bytes. For other queries, the column value is 0.

columns.name: memory_usage
columns.comment: The difference between the amount of allocated and freed memory in context of this thread.

columns.name: peak_memory_usage
columns.comment: The maximum difference between the amount of allocated and freed memory in context of this thread.

columns.name: thread_name
columns.comment: Name of the thread.

columns.name: thread_id
columns.comment: Internal thread ID.

columns.name: master_thread_id
columns.comment: OS initial ID of initial thread.

columns.name: current_database
columns.comment: Name of the current database.

columns.name: query
columns.comment: Query string.

columns.name: normalized_query_hash
columns.comment: The hash of normalized query - with wiped constants, etc.

columns.name: is_initial_query
columns.comment: Whether the query is initial. Possible values: 1 — an initial (top-level) query, 0 — a child query initiated by another query, including queries for distributed execution and internal subqueries.

columns.name: connection_address
